stories.title: Cincinnati upsets No. 8 Texas Tech behind French's 4 TD passes
stories.summary: Cole Tabb had a career-high 173 rushing yards and a touchdown and JC French IV threw for a career-high four TD passes as Cincinnati stunned No. 8 Texas Tech 37-24 on Saturday.

stories.title: Ravens rule out QB Jackson (ankle) Sunday vs. Bengals; Huntley to start
stories.summary: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out of Sundays game vs. the Cincinnati Bengals as he continues to deal with a high ankle sprain. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will get the start.

stories.title: Valkyries regroup, beat Dream to even WNBA Finals at 2-2
stories.summary: The Valkyries played stellar defense to beat the Dream and even the WNBA Finals at 2-2.

stories.title: Packers activate RB Jacobs for 2026 debut after time on exempt list
stories.summary: Packers running back Josh Jacobs will make his 2026 season debut against the Lions after spending the first six weeks on the NFL's commissioner exempt list.

stories.title: Toney, Mensah dominate as Canes open No. 1 reign with rout
stories.summary: Malachi Toney had a school-record 16 catches and Darian Mensah threw for 387 yards and four TDs as No. 1 Miami rolled past Pitt 52-23.
